value_stream.name: Self-Checkout, Scan-&-Go & Unattended Retail Technology Operations

fields.Participants: LP (VS-23), Frontend (VS-08), BI (VS-28), Security (VS-27.3), HR (VS-103), Store Ops (VS-07)
fields.Trigger: SCO operation; loss analytics; exception feed

Automation Opportunity: - Loss-pattern ML detection; weight-mismatch/swap/sweethearting rules; CCTV/exception auto-correlation; case workflow
Controls: - CTL-679: loss analytics run continuously; cases investigated with evidence; collusion-prevention trained; rules tuned; internal-fraud handled (VS-125)
Cross-references: - links to VS-23 (LP), VS-125 (fraud), VS-23.2 (CCTV), VS-103 (HR), W4437 (loss design), W4450 (exception), W4455 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Undetected-scan-avoidance risk**: SCO loss silently erodes wage savings; mitigated by analytics + weight-security (W4437)
- **Internal-collusion risk**: attendant enables scan-avoidance for accomplice; mitigated by override-pattern analytics & SoD
System Touchpoints: - LP analytics/exception (VS-23/W4450); CCTV (VS-23.2); BI (VS-28); fraud case (VS-125); HR (VS-103); security (VS-27.3)

steps.activity: LP/BI run SCO/scan-&-go loss analytics — scan-avoidance (item not scanned), weight-mismatch rate, barcode-swap (cheap-on-expensive), sweethearting (attendant override pattern), and basket-anomaly detection
LP triage high-risk cases, pull CCTV/exception evidence (W4450), distinguish customer-fraud from internal-collusion (attendant), and open case (W4450/VS-125)
LP/Frontend tune the detection rules (W4437), train attendants on collusion-prevention, and handle internal-fraud per HR/legal (VS-103/VS-100)

fields.Participants: LP (VS-23), Frontend (VS-08), IT (VS-27), Security (VS-27.3), HR (VS-103), Legal (VS-100)
fields.Volume: SCO exceptions = flag/override/error rate × SCO volume

Automation Opportunity: - Exception-CCTV auto-link; case-lifecycle workflow with SLA; evidence vault; recovery tracking
Controls: - CTL-679 (ensure controlled execution — Loss Prevention, Cash, Compliance & Analytics (PA-149.3).)
- CTL-679: exceptions captured with CCTV evidence; triaged & investigated; cases resolved per policy; learning fed to design
Cross-references: - links to VS-23 (LP), VS-23.2 (CCTV), VS-103 (HR), VS-100 (legal), VS-125 (fraud), W4443 (intervention), W4449 (loss), W4455 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Evidence-loss risk**: exception without CCTV clip → unprovable; mitigated by auto-linked CCTV capture
- **Case-drag risk**: cases unresolved → backlog; mitigated by case-lifecycle SLA
System Touchpoints: - Exception/case system; CCTV (VS-23.2); LP (VS-23); HR (VS-103); legal (VS-100); fraud (VS-125); security (VS-27.3)

steps.activity: IT/LP capture SCO exceptions (weight-mismatch, override, void, error, exit-verify-fail) with auto-linked CCTV clip, into the exception/case system
LP triage exceptions — resolve routine (false-positive), investigate suspicious (W4449), and manage the case lifecycle (evidence, interview, action)
LP/HR/Legal handle confirmed cases — recovery (civil/VS-100), employee action (VS-103/VS-84), customer/law-enforcement referral (VS-125), and feed learning to design (W4437)

fields.Frequency: Per event (~2% return rate × SCO volume)
fields.Participants: Frontend (VS-08), Customer Service (VS-09), Returns (VS-32), LP (VS-23), Finance (VS-17), Compliance (VS-22)

Automation Opportunity: - SoD-authorized refund workflow; original-transaction validation; void/refund anomaly analytics; auto tax/VAT reversal
Controls: - CTL-679 (ensure controlled execution — Loss Prevention, Cash, Compliance & Analytics (PA-149.3).)
- CTL-679: refund/void authorized per SoD; original validated; inventory/loyalty/tax reversed; anomalies investigated; reconciled
Cross-references: - links to VS-08 (POS), VS-32 (returns), VS-23 (LP), VS-17/VS-16 (GL/AR), VS-79 (tax), W4443 (override), W4449 (fraud)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Refund-fraud risk**: fake/void refund cashed out → leakage; mitigated by SoD authorization & anomaly analytics
- **Tax-reversal-error risk**: VAT not reversed → tax distortion; mitigated by system-driven reversal
System Touchpoints: - POS/ERP (VS-08); returns (VS-32); LP/exception (VS-23/W4450); GL/AR (VS-17/VS-16); tax (VS-79); records (VS-88)

steps.activity: Frontend/Customer Service process SCO refund/return/void with attendant/manager authorization (SoD, W4443), validate the original transaction, and reverse inventory/loyalty
LP/Finance flag SCO refund/void anomalies (excessive voids, refund-to-cash-pattern, fake-receipt) for investigation (W4449/W4450) — a common SCO fraud vector
Finance/Compliance reconcile reversals to GL/AR (VS-17/VS-16), ensure tax/VAT reversal correctness (VS-79), and retain evidence (VS-88)

fields.Participants: Cash Office (VS-08.2), Frontend (VS-08), LP (VS-23), Finance (VS-17), Treasury (VS-18), Store Ops (VS-07)

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-reconciliation per terminal/attendant; variance-threshold alert; CCTV-recycler correlation; recovery/write-off workflow
Controls: - CTL-679: daily reconciliation per terminal/attendant; variances over threshold investigated with CCTV; recovered/written-off per policy; recurrent charged
Cross-references: - links to VS-08.2 (cash office), VS-23 (LP/CCTV), VS-17 (GL), VS-18 (treasury), W4445 (cash mgmt), W4446 (recycler fault), W4449 (fraud)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cash-leakage risk**: unreconciled SCO cash → hidden loss; mitigated by daily reconciliation & threshold-investigation
- **False-variance risk**: recycler fault mis-read as theft; mitigated by recycler-fault check (W4446) before investigation
System Touchpoints: - Cash office (VS-08.2); cash-recycler; LP/CCTV (VS-23/VS-23.2); GL (VS-17); treasury (VS-18); recycler-fault (W4446); BI (VS-28)

steps.activity: Cash Office reconcile SCO cash (recycler + attendant drawer) to system tenders daily, calculate variance, and log per terminal/attendant
LP/Cash Office investigate variances over threshold — CCTV review (VS-23.2), attendant pattern, recycler fault (W4446), fraud (W4449)
Finance/LP recover/write-off per policy, charge recurrent variances to process/individual, and tune threshold/recycler (W4445/W4446)

fields.Participants: Tax (VS-79), Compliance (VS-22), Frontend (VS-08), IT (VS-27), Audit (VS-21), Legal (VS-100)
fields.Trigger: SCO operation; BIR audit; regulation change

workflows.name: SCO Compliance — BIR CAS, e-Invoicing, Price/Tag (RA 7394)

Automation Opportunity: - CAS-registered SCO with auto e-invoice; price-accuracy audit (links VS-118); BIR-audit support pack; regulation-change monitoring
Controls: - CTL-679: SCO CAS-registered & e-invoicing; BIR-compliant receipt/serial; price-tag integrity (RA 7394); records retained; BIR-audit supported
Cross-references: - links to VS-79 (tax/BIR), VS-22 (compliance), VS-118 (revenue assurance/price), VS-88 (records), W4442 (transaction), W4451 (refund)
Pain Points / Risks: - **CAS/e-invoice-non-compliance risk**: SCO not CAS-registered / no e-invoice → BIR penalty; mitigated by CAS registration & e-invoicing
- **Price-integrity risk**: scanned ≠ displayed → Consumer Act violation + customer trust; mitigated by price-accuracy audit (links VS-118)
System Touchpoints: - BIR CAS/e-invoice (VS-79); POS-ERP (VS-08); compliance (VS-22); audit (VS-21); records (VS-88); legal (VS-100)

steps.activity: Tax/Compliance ensure SCO terminals are BIR **CAS-registered** (Computerized Accounting System), issue BIR-compliant receipts/serials, and integrate e-invoicing (per BIR rollout)
Compliance/Frontend enforce Consumer Act (RA 7394) price-tag/integrity at SCO — scanned price = displayed price, price-accuracy audit, price-mismatch handling
Tax/Audit support BIR audit (VS-79/VS-21) of SCO transactions/receipts/e-invoices, retain records (VS-88), and update on regulation change

fields.Participants: CX (VS-13), Frontend (VS-08), Visual Merch (VS-55), Customer Safety (VS-147), Compliance (VS-22), Enablement (VS-124)

Automation Opportunity: - Accessibility-design checklist (BP 344); PWD-priority lane routing; accessibility-feedback analytics; UX iteration
Controls: - CTL-679 (ensure controlled execution — Loss Prevention, Cash, Compliance & Analytics (PA-149.3).)
- CTL-679: SCO BP 344-accessible; PWD/senior assistance & alternative; accessibility audited; iterated on feedback
Cross-references: - links to VS-13 (CX), VS-55 (visual merch), VS-147/W4400 (safety/vulnerable), VS-146 (service quality), VS-22 (compliance), W4435 (layout), W4455 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Exclusion risk**: SCO unusable by PWD/senior → exclusion + BP 344 violation; mitigated by accessible design & assistance
- **Fairness risk**: SCO-only format pressures vulnerable customers; mitigated by staffed-POS alternative
System Touchpoints: - CX (VS-13); visual merch/design (VS-55); customer safety (VS-147); compliance (VS-22); enablement (VS-124); service-quality (VS-146)
Time Estimate: - Per-design; continuous assistance folded into frontend

steps.activity: CX/Frontend design SCO for accessibility — BP 344 reach/clearance/screen/audio, PWD-priority lane, senior-friendly UX, attendant assistance, multilingual (links VS-147/W4400)
Frontend/Attendants proactively assist PWD/senior at SCO, offer staffed-POS alternative, and capture accessibility feedback (VS-13/VS-146)
CX/Compliance audit accessibility compliance (BP 344, RA 7394 fairness), iterate on feedback, and report (W4455/VS-146)

fields.Participants: BI (VS-28), Frontend (VS-08), Strategy (VS-33), Finance (VS-17.4), LP (VS-23), CX (VS-13), IT (VS-27)

Automation Opportunity: - Balanced-scorecard dashboard; business-case-vs-actual tracker; anomaly detection; format-evolution recommender
Controls: - CTL-679 (ensure controlled execution — Loss Prevention, Cash, Compliance & Analytics (PA-149.3).)
- CTL-679: balanced KPIs tracked; benchmarked vs business case; shortfalls actioned; ROI measured; reported to COO/CFO
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (BI), VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-33 (strategy), VS-23 (LP), W4433 (strategy/business case), W4456 (evolution)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Value-not-realized risk**: adoption/loss/wage-savings short of business case; mitigated by business-case-vs-actual tracking & action
- **Metric-blindness risk**: tracking only adoption (not loss/throughput); mitigated by balanced KPI set
System Touchpoints: - BI (VS-28); POS-ERP (VS-08); LP (VS-23); finance FP&A (VS-17.4); strategy (VS-33); CX (VS-13); IT (VS-27)

steps.activity: BI/Frontend build SCO/scan-&-go analytics — adoption (% baskets), throughput (items/min), wait-time, intervention rate, uptime/MTTR, loss-rate (W4449), cash-variance (W4452), cost-per-transaction, by store/profile
Strategy/Finance benchmark vs business case (W4433) — wage savings realized, loss-rate vs target, ROI/payback tracking, and adoption vs target
Frontend/Strategy act on analytics — right-size layout (W4435), tune loss-rules (W4437), iterate UX (W4447), and plan format evolution (W4456)

Frontend/OpEx drive continuous improvement — eliminate friction points, tune loss-rules (W4437), optimize layout (W4435)/staffing (W4448), per analytics (W4455)
